QUOTE: By default that renames the member to `private_foo`, so `ctx->foo` no longer compiles from application code. ... `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally ... inside the library `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to plain `x`. ... Application code that does not define the macro gets a compile error on any direct field access
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer contrasts code that defines the macro, which gets plain member names, with ordinary application code, which gets the renamed `private_` members.
